verdict.rationale: Fathom offers event-driven automation: webhooks fire on new meeting content with configurable payloads (summary, transcript, action items, CRM matches), CRM records update automatically after meetings, and keyword alerts and topic monitoring are advertised. There is no evidence of a user-definable rule engine with conditions mapped to arbitrary actions, so custom rule logic must be built on the user's own webhook endpoint. Missing for 10: native configurable rule/condition builder, event types beyond new meeting content, documented alert-triggered actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
